records.literal_gloss: [A] son of eight year[s] [was] Josiah when he became king, and thirty and one year[s] he reigned in Jerusalem; and [the] name of his mother [was] Jedidah daughter of Adaiah from Bozkath.

en.L: A son of eight years [was] Josiah when he became king, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem. And the name of his mother [was] Jedidah daughter of Adaiah from Bozkath.
en.B: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Jedidah daughter of Adaiah from Bozkath.
en.R: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he ruled for thirty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah from Bozkath.

es.L: Hijo de ocho años [era] Josías cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó treinta y un años en Jerusalén. Y el nombre de su madre [era] Jedida hija de Adaía, de Boscat.
es.B: Josías tenía ocho años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó treinta y un años en Jerusalén. Su madre se llamaba Jedida hija de Adaía, de Boscat.
es.R: Josías tenía ocho años cuando llegó a ser rey, y gobernó en Jerusalén durante treinta y un años. Su madre se llamaba Jedida y era hija de Adaía, de Boscat.

fr.L: Josias avait huit ans quand il devint roi, et il régna trente et un ans à Jérusalem. Et le nom de sa mère [était] Yedida fille d’Adaya, de Botsqath.
fr.B: Josias avait huit ans quand il devint roi, et il régna trente et un ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s’appelait Yedida, fille d’Adaya, de Botsqath.
fr.R: Josias avait huit ans quand il est devenu roi, et il a régné à Jérusalem pendant trente et un ans. Sa mère s’appelait Yedida ; c’était la fille d’Adaya, de Botsqath.

sw.L: Yosia [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka minane alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka thelathini na mmoja huko Yerusalemu. Na jina la mama yake [lilikuwa] Yedida binti Adaya wa Boskathi.
sw.B: Yosia alikuwa na umri wa miaka minane alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka thelathini na mmoja huko Yerusalemu. Mama yake aliitwa Yedida binti Adaya wa Boskathi.
sw.R: Yosia alikuwa na umri wa miaka minane alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka thelathini na mmoja. Mama yake aliitwa Yedida binti Adaya wa Boskathi.

vi.L: Giô-si-a [được] tám tuổi khi lên làm vua, và trị vì ba mươi mốt năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Tên mẹ ông [là] Giê-đi-đa con gái A-đa-gia, người Bốt-cát.
vi.B: Giô-si-a được tám tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì ba mươi mốt năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Mẹ vua tên là Giê-đi-đa con gái A-đa-gia, người Bốt-cát.
vi.R: Giô-si-a được tám tuổi khi lên làm vua, và ông cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem ba mươi mốt năm. Mẹ vua tên là Giê-đi-đa, con gái A-đa-gia, người Bốt-cát.

ko.L: 요시야가 왕이 되었을 때 팔 세[였고], 예루살렘에서 삼십일 년 동안 다스렸다. 그리고 그의 어머니의 이름은 보스갓 출신 아다야의 딸 여디다였다.
ko.B: 요시야는 팔 세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 삼십일 년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니의 이름은 보스갓 출신 아다야의 딸 여디다였다.
ko.R: 요시야는 여덟 살에 왕이 되었고, 예루살렘에서 삼십일 년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니는 보스갓 출신 아다야의 딸 여디다였다.

decisions.choice: a son of eight years: eight years old
decisions.reason: Hebrew gives a person's age as being "a son of" so many years (12:1; 18:2).

decisions.choice: eight years old: made king as a boy after his father was murdered
decisions.reason: Josiah's father Amon was killed by his own officials after reigning two years, and the people of the land put the eight-year-old Josiah on the throne (21:19, 23-24). The prophecy of 1 Kings 13:2 had named Josiah of the house of David long before.

decisions.choice: his mother: the queen mother named in the formula; Bozkath, a town of Judah
decisions.reason: For each king of Judah the formula names his mother, who held a place of honor at court (1 Kings 15:13; 2 Kings 18:2). Bozkath was a town in the lowland of Judah, toward Lachish (Joshua 15:39). The name Jedidah means "beloved", close to the name Jedidiah given to Solomon (2 Samuel 12:25).

decisions.choice: Josiah's reign is also told in 2 Chronicles 34-35
decisions.reason: Chronicles retells this chapter in 2 Chronicles 34:1-2 and 34:8-28, with a few differences noted at the verses where they fall.

decisions.choice: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned thirty-one years
decisions.reason: The wording kept for the accession formula throughout Kings (12:1-2; 18:2). Literal keeps the Hebrew "a son of eight years" and its order; Readable says "ruled" and splits off the mother's name.

decisions.choice: "Hijo de ocho años era" (L); "tenía ocho años cuando comenzó a reinar" (B); "Jedida", "Adaía", "Boscat"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "son of eight years", as the English Literal does; Balanced keeps the terms note's formula. The names in their usual Spanish forms.

decisions.choice: Josias
decisions.reason: The usual French form, as the terms note sets and Matthew 1 has it.

source.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּכָל־דֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֔יו וְלֹא־סָ֖ר יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאול׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And he did the right in [the] eyes of Yahweh, and he walked in all [the] way of David his father, and not he turned aside right and left.

en.L: And he did the right in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and walked in all the way of David his father, and he did not turn aside [to the] right or [to the] left.
en.B: He did what was right in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and walked in all the way of his ancestor David. He did not turn aside to the right or to the left.
en.R: Josiah did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was right. He lived in every way as his ancestor David had lived, and he did not wander off the path, either to the right or to the left.

es.L: E hizo lo recto a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y anduvo en todo el camino de David su padre, y no se apartó ni a derecha ni a izquierda.
es.B: Hizo lo recto a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y anduvo en todo el camino de su antepasado David. No se desvió ni a la derecha ni a la izquierda.
es.R: Josías hizo lo que agrada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Vivió en todo como había vivido su antepasado David, y no se salió del camino ni a la derecha ni a la izquierda.

fr.L: Et il fit ce qui est droit aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et il marcha dans toute la voie de David son père, et il ne s’en écarta ni à droite ni à gauche.
fr.B: Il fit ce qui est juste aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et suivit en tout le chemin de son ancêtre David, sans s’en écarter ni à droite ni à gauche.
fr.R: Josias a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare bon. Il a vécu en tout point comme son ancêtre David, et il ne s’est pas écarté du bon chemin, ni à droite ni à gauche.

sw.L: Naye akafanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akaenenda katika njia yote ya Daudi baba yake, wala hakugeuka [kwenda] kulia wala kushoto.
sw.B: Alifanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akaenenda katika njia yote ya babu yake Daudi. Hakugeuka kwenda kulia wala kushoto.
sw.R: Yosia alifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mema. Aliishi kwa kila namna kama babu yake Daudi alivyoishi, wala hakupotoka katika njia, kulia wala kushoto.

vi.L: Ông làm điều ngay thẳng trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đi trong mọi đường lối của Đa-vít tổ phụ ông, không xây [qua] bên phải hay bên trái.
vi.B: Ông làm điều ngay thẳng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và đi trong mọi đường lối của Đa-vít tổ tiên ông. Ông không xây qua bên phải hay bên trái.
vi.R: Giô-si-a làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là phải. Ông sống mọi mặt giống như Đa-vít tổ tiên ông đã sống, và không đi lệch khỏi đường ngay, dù sang phải hay sang trái.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 올바른 일을 했고, 그의 조상 다윗의 모든 길로 걸었으며, 오른쪽으로도 왼쪽으로도 벗어나지 않았다.
ko.B: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 올바른 일을 했고, 그의 조상 다윗의 길을 그대로 따라 걸었다. 그는 오른쪽으로도 왼쪽으로도 치우치지 않았다.
ko.R: 요시야는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 옳다고 하신 일을 했다. 그는 모든 면에서 그의 조상 다윗처럼 살았다. 그는 오른쪽으로도 왼쪽으로도 길에서 벗어나지 않았다.

decisions.choice: did what was right in Yahweh's eyes: the good verdict, with no reservation
decisions.reason: This is the good verdict of the regnal formula (12:3; 18:3). No limit is added, as it was for earlier kings who left the high places standing (12:4; 15:4). Josiah is the last king of Judah to receive it, and 23:25 says that no king before or after him turned to Yahweh as he did.

decisions.choice: walked in all the way of David his father: lived as his ancestor David had lived
decisions.reason: To walk in a way is to live by a pattern of conduct. David lived more than three hundred years earlier; "father" also means a forefather, and Kings measures each king of Judah against him (1 Kings 15:3, 11; 2 Kings 18:3).

decisions.choice: did not turn aside to the right or to the left: the words Deuteronomy uses for keeping the law
decisions.reason: God's commands are pictured as a road that must not be left in either direction. Moses uses these words for all Israel (Deuteronomy 5:32; 28:14) and for the king, who is to read the law all his life and "not turn aside from the commandment, right or left" (Deuteronomy 17:18-20); Joshua is told the same (Joshua 1:7). Josiah is the king who did what Deuteronomy asks of a king.

decisions.choice: did the right in [the] eyes of / did what was right in the sight of / did what the LORD said was right
decisions.reason: The wording kept for the good verdict at each level throughout these books.

decisions.choice: his ancestor David; did not wander off the path
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "ancestor" for "father" where David is called the father of a later king, as 18:3 does. Readable says "did not wander off the path, either to the right or to the left", the words it uses in Deuteronomy 5:32, so that the echo (m3) can be heard.

decisions.choice: "hizo lo recto a los ojos del SEÑOR" (L, B); "hizo lo que agrada al SEÑOR" (R); "su antepasado David" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The good verdict keeps the terms note's wording at each level; Balanced and Readable say "antepasado" for David.

source.text: וַיְהִ֗י בִּשְׁמֹנֶ֤ה עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ יֹאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ שָׁלַ֣ח הַ֠מֶּלֶךְ אֶת־שָׁפָ֨ן בֶּן־אֲצַלְיָ֤הוּ בֶן־מְשֻׁלָּם֙ הַסֹּפֵ֔ר בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was in [the] eighteenth year of the king Josiah, sent the king Shaphan son of Azaliah son of Meshullam the scribe [to the] house of Yahweh, saying,

en.L: And it was in the eighteenth year of King Josiah, the king sent Shaphan son of Azaliah, son of Meshullam, the scribe, [to the] house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, saying,
en.B: In the eighteenth year of King Josiah, the king sent the secretary Shaphan son of Azaliah, son of Meshullam, to the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, saying,
en.R: In the eighteenth year that Josiah was king, he sent Shaphan son of Azaliah, son of Meshullam, the royal secretary, to the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He told him,

es.L: Y sucedió en el año dieciocho del rey Josías, que el rey envió a Safán hijo de Azalía, hijo de Mesulam, el escriba, [a la] casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, diciendo:
es.B: En el año dieciocho del rey Josías, el rey envió al secretario Safán hijo de Azalía, hijo de Mesulam, a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, diciendo:
es.R: En el año dieciocho de su reinado, Josías envió al templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} a Safán hijo de Azalía, hijo de Mesulam, el secretario del rey. Le dijo:

fr.L: Et il arriva, en la dix-huitième année du roi Josias, [que] le roi envoya Shaphân fils d’Atsalia, fils de Meshoullam, le scribe, [à] la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, en disant :
fr.B: La dix-huitième année du roi Josias, le roi envoya le secrétaire Shaphân, fils d’Atsalia, fils de Meshoullam, à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, en lui disant :
fr.R: La dix-huitième année de son règne, Josias a envoyé Shaphân fils d’Atsalia, fils de Meshoullam, le secrétaire du roi, au temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Il lui a dit :

sw.L: Ikawa katika mwaka wa kumi na nane wa mfalme Yosia, mfalme akamtuma Shafani mwana wa Azalia, mwana wa Meshulamu, mwandishi, [kwenda] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akisema,
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa kumi na nane wa mfalme Yosia, mfalme alimtuma katibu Shafani mwana wa Azalia, mwana wa Meshulamu, kwenda nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akisema,
sw.R: Katika mwaka wa kumi na nane wa utawala wake, Yosia alimtuma Shafani mwana wa Azalia, mwana wa Meshulamu, katibu wa mfalme, kwenda hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Akamwambia,

vi.B: Năm thứ mười tám đời vua Giô-si-a, vua sai thư ký Sa-phan con trai A-xa-lia, cháu Mê-su-lam, đến nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và dặn:
vi.R: Năm thứ mười tám đời Giô-si-a làm vua, vua sai Sa-phan con trai A-xa-lia, cháu Mê-su-lam, là thư ký của vua, đến đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Vua dặn ông:

ko.L: 그리고 요시야 왕의 제십팔년에 왕이 므술람의 손자 아살리야의 아들 서기관 사반을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집으로 보내며 말했다.
ko.B: 요시야 왕이 다스린 지 십팔 년째 되는 해에, 왕은 므술람의 손자요 아살리야의 아들인 서기관 사반을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집으로 보내며 말했다.
ko.R: 요시야가 왕이 된 지 십팔 년째 되는 해에, 그는 왕의 서기관 사반을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전으로 보냈다. 사반은 아살리야의 아들이고 므술람의 손자였다. 왕이 그에게 말했다.

decisions.choice: the eighteenth year of King Josiah: when Josiah was about twenty-six
decisions.reason: Josiah became king at eight (verse 1), so in his eighteenth year he was about twenty-six. The book is found and the Passover kept in this same year (23:23).

decisions.choice: 2 Chronicles 34 puts Josiah's first reforms earlier
decisions.reason: 2 Chronicles 34:3-7 says that Josiah began to seek God in his eighth year and to purge Judah and Jerusalem of idols in his twelfth, before the book was found. Kings tells the whole reform after the finding of the book (chapter 23). 2 Chronicles 34:8 adds that Maaseiah the governor of the city and Joah the recorder were sent with Shaphan.

decisions.choice: Shaphan the scribe: the royal secretary
decisions.reason: The scribe was one of the king's chief officials, who kept records and handled royal business (12:11; 18:18). Shaphan and his sons appear again in verse 12 and in Jeremiah (Jeremiah 26:24; 36:10-12).

decisions.choice: the sentence goes on into verse 4
decisions.reason: "Saying" introduces the king's orders, which run from verse 4 to the end of verse 7.

decisions.choice: the scribe (Literal); the secretary (Balanced); the royal secretary (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 12:11, Balanced and Readable name the office by its modern equivalent; Literal keeps "scribe". Readable says "temple" for "house of the LORD", as these books do.

decisions.choice: "el escriba" (L); "el secretario" (B); "el secretario del rey" (R); "Safán"
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the office as the terms note sets ("el secretario"); Literal keeps "escriba", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "le scribe" (L); "le secrétaire" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English, Literal keeps "scribe" and the other levels give the office, "secrétaire", as the terms note sets for the royal secretary.

decisions.choice: mwandishi (Literal); katibu (Balanced); katibu wa mfalme (Readable)
decisions.reason: The royal scribe, who was the king's secretary (meaning decision m3); the terms note's "katibu" at Balanced and Readable, the older "mwandishi" at Literal.

decisions.choice: thư ký at every level
decisions.reason: The office keeps the terms note word "thư ký" at every level, as for Shebna in 18:18.

decisions.choice: "서기관" (L, B), "왕의 서기관" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's title for the royal secretary, kept for Shaphan through chapters 22-23.

source.text: עֲלֵ֗ה אֶל־חִלְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֔וֹל וְיַתֵּ֣ם אֶת־הַכֶּ֔סֶף הַמּוּבָ֖א בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָסְפ֛וּ שֹׁמְרֵ֥י הַסַּ֖ף מֵאֵ֥ת הָעָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Go up to Hilkiah the priest the great, and let him complete the money brought [into the] house of Yahweh, which have gathered [the] keepers of the threshold from the people,

en.L: "Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, and let him complete the money that has been brought [into the] house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, which the keepers of the threshold have gathered from the people,
en.B: "Go up to Hilkiah the high priest and have him count up the money brought into the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the money the doorkeepers have taken in from the people,
en.R: "Go to Hilkiah the high priest. Have him count the money that people have brought to the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. The men who guard the entrance have collected it from the people.

es.L: «Sube a Hilcías el sumo sacerdote, y que complete el dinero que ha sido traído [a la] casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, que han recogido del pueblo los guardianes del umbral,
es.B: «Sube a ver a Hilcías el sumo sacerdote y que cuente el dinero que se ha traído a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el dinero que los porteros han recibido del pueblo,
es.R: «Ve a ver a Hilcías el sumo sacerdote. Que cuente el dinero que la gente ha traído al templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Los hombres que cuidan la entrada lo han recogido del pueblo.

fr.L: « Monte vers Hilqiya, le grand prêtre, et qu’il fasse le compte de l’argent apporté [dans] la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, que les gardiens du seuil ont recueilli auprès du peuple,
fr.B: « Monte trouver Hilqiya, le grand prêtre, et qu’il fasse le compte de l’argent apporté dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, l’argent que les gardiens du seuil ont recueilli auprès du peuple.
fr.R: « Va voir Hilqiya, le grand prêtre. Demande-lui de compter l’argent que les gens ont apporté au temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Ce sont les gardiens de l’entrée qui l’ont recueilli auprès du peuple.

sw.L: "Panda kwa Hilkia kuhani mkuu, naye aikamilishe fedha iliyoletwa [katika] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambayo walinzi wa kizingiti wameikusanya kutoka kwa watu,
sw.B: "Panda uende kwa Hilkia kuhani mkuu, umwambie aihesabu fedha iliyoletwa katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, fedha ambayo mabawabu wameipokea kutoka kwa watu,
sw.R: "Nenda kwa Hilkia kuhani mkuu. Mwambie aihesabu fedha ambayo watu wameileta katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Walinzi wa malango wameikusanya kutoka kwa watu.

vi.L: "Hãy đi lên gặp thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm Hinh-kia, và bảo ông ấy tính tổng số bạc đã được đem vào nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là bạc mà những người giữ ngưỡng cửa đã thu từ dân chúng,
vi.B: "Hãy đi lên gặp thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm Hinh-kia và bảo ông ấy tính số bạc đã được đem vào nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là số bạc những người giữ cửa đã thu của dân chúng,
vi.R: "Hãy đến gặp thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm Hinh-kia. Bảo ông ấy đếm số bạc mà dân chúng đã đem đến đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Những người canh giữ lối vào đã thu số bạc ấy từ dân chúng.

ko.L: "대제사장 힐기야에게 올라가서, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 들어온 돈, 곧 문지기들이 백성에게서 거둔 돈을 그가 계산하게 하여라.
ko.B: "대제사장 힐기야에게 올라가서, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 들어온 돈, 곧 문지기들이 백성에게서 거둔 돈을 다 세게 하여라.
ko.R: "대제사장 힐기야에게 가거라. 사람들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 가져온 돈을 그에게 세게 하여라. 그 돈은 입구를 지키는 사람들이 백성에게서 거둔 것이다.

decisions.choice: let him complete the money: have him count it up, reckon the total
alternatives: let him melt down the money
decisions.reason: The verb means to complete or finish, and here most likely to make up the full sum, counting out what had come in. Some read a very similar verb meaning to pour out or melt down, the word Shaphan uses in verse 9, but the written text has "complete".

decisions.choice: the keepers of the threshold: the priests who guarded the temple entrance
decisions.reason: These are the doorkeepers who received the people's gifts at the entrance and put them in the chest that Jehoash had set up (12:10). Josiah uses the arrangement made for the repairs under Jehoash (12:10-16).

decisions.choice: Hilkiah the high priest
decisions.reason: Literally "the great priest", the title of the chief priest (12:11; Leviticus 21:10). Hilkiah is named among the ancestors of Ezra (Ezra 7:1; 1 Chronicles 5:39).

decisions.choice: the sentence goes on into verse 5
decisions.reason: The king's orders form one long sentence from here to the end of verse 6: count the money, hand it to the overseers, and have them pay the workmen.

decisions.choice: doorkeepers (Balanced); the men who guard the entrance (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the duty that "keepers of the threshold" stands for, as at 12:10; Literal keeps the picture.

decisions.choice: "los guardianes del umbral" (L); "los porteros" (B); "los hombres que cuidan la entrada" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew title; Balanced uses the terms note's "porteros", and Readable says what they did, as the English does.

decisions.choice: walinzi wa kizingiti (Literal); mabawabu (Balanced); walinzi wa malango (Readable)
decisions.reason: The keepers of the threshold in the terms note's wording for gatekeepers at Balanced and Readable.

source.text: וְיִתְּנֻ֗הוּ עַל־יַד֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה הַמֻּפְקָדִ֖ים בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וְיִתְּנ֣וּ אֹת֗וֹ לְעֹשֵׂ֤י הַמְּלָאכָה֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה לְחַזֵּ֖ק בֶּ֥דֶק הַבָּֽיִת׃

records.literal_gloss: and let them give it on [the] hand of [the] doers of the work, those appointed [in the] house of Yahweh; and let them give it to [the] doers of the work who [are] in [the] house of Yahweh, to repair [the] breach of the house,

en.L: and let them give it into [the] hand of the doers of the work, who are appointed in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; and let them give it to the doers of the work who [are] in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to repair the breach of the house,
en.B: and have them hand it to the men doing the work, who have been put in charge of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Let these pay it to the workmen in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who are repairing the damage to the house,
en.R: Then have them give it to the men who have been put in charge of the work on the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. These men are to pay the workers who are repairing the temple.

es.L: y que lo entreguen en mano de los que hacen la obra, los encargados en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; y que lo den a los que hacen la obra que [están] en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, para reparar las grietas de la casa,
es.B: y que lo entreguen a los que hacen la obra, los que han sido puestos a cargo de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Que estos se lo paguen a los obreros que trabajan en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} reparando los daños de la casa,
es.R: Luego que se lo den a los hombres encargados de la obra del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Ellos tienen que pagar a los trabajadores que están reparando el templo.

fr.L: et qu’on le remette entre les mains de ceux qui font l’ouvrage, qui sont préposés à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; et qu’ils le donnent à ceux qui font l’ouvrage dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, pour réparer les brèches de la maison :
fr.B: Qu’on le remette aux responsables des travaux, chargés de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et qu’ils en paient les ouvriers qui travaillent dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} à réparer les dégâts de la maison :
fr.R: Ensuite, il faut le donner aux hommes qui sont chargés des travaux du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Ces hommes paieront les ouvriers qui réparent le temple.

sw.L: nao waitie katika mkono wa watendaji wa kazi, walioteuliwa katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; nao waitoe kwa watendaji wa kazi walio katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ili kuutengeneza ufa wa nyumba,
sw.B: nao waikabidhi kwa watu wanaofanya kazi, waliowekwa kuisimamia nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hao waitoe kwa mafundi walio katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wanaoyatengeneza maharibiko ya nyumba,
sw.R: Kisha waitoe kwa watu waliowekwa kusimamia kazi ya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Watu hao wawalipe wafanyakazi wanaotengeneza hekalu.

vi.L: và hãy giao nó vào tay những người làm công việc, là những người được giao coi sóc nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; và hãy để họ giao nó cho những người làm công việc trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, để sửa chữa chỗ hư hại của nhà,
vi.B: và giao cho những người phụ trách công việc, là những người được giao coi sóc nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Họ sẽ trả cho những thợ đang làm việc trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để sửa chữa những chỗ hư hại của nhà,
vi.R: Rồi hãy giao số bạc ấy cho những người được giao trông coi công việc ở đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Những người này sẽ trả công cho những thợ đang sửa chữa đền thờ.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그것을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 임명된, 일하는 자들의 손에 주게 하고, 그들이 그것을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 일하는 자들에게 주어 그 집의 무너진 곳을 고치게 하여라.
ko.B: 그리고 그 돈을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 공사를 맡은 감독들에게 넘겨주어, 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 일하며 그 집의 파손된 곳을 수리하는 일꾼들에게 주게 하여라.
ko.R: 그리고 그 돈을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 공사를 맡은 감독들에게 주게 하여라. 그들은 성전을 수리하는 일꾼들에게 품삯을 줄 것이다.

decisions.choice: let them give it ... the house: the readings in the margin
decisions.reason: In two places the letters written in the Hebrew text differ slightly from the reading given in the margin: in the form of "let them give it", and where the margin reads "in the house" for "the house". The record follows the margin; the sense is the same either way.

decisions.choice: the doers of the work: first the overseers, then the workmen they pay
decisions.reason: The phrase is used twice. The first time it names the men appointed over the work, who receive the money; the second time it names the workmen in the temple whom they pay, listed in verse 6. 12:12 has the same two steps.

decisions.choice: to repair the breach of the house: the words of the repairs under Jehoash
decisions.reason: The words follow 12:6, 12 and 15 closely. The temple, built some three hundred and fifty years earlier, needed repair again after the long reign of Manasseh, who had set up altars to other gods in its courts (21:4-5).

decisions.choice: the breach of the house (Literal); the damage to the house (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The same wording as in 12:6 and 12:12, where the Hebrew is the same. Readable says "repairing the temple".

source.text: לֶחָ֣רָשִׁ֔ים וְלַבֹּנִ֖ים וְלַגֹּֽדְרִ֑ים וְלִקְנ֤וֹת עֵצִים֙ וְאַבְנֵ֣י מַחְצֵ֔ב לְחַזֵּ֖ק אֶת־הַבָּֽיִת׃

records.literal_gloss: to the craftsmen and to the builders and to the masons, and to buy timber and stones of hewing to repair the house.

en.L: to the craftsmen and to the builders and to the masons, and to buy timber and hewn stones to repair the house.
en.B: to the craftsmen, the builders and the masons, and let them buy timber and dressed stone to repair the house.
en.R: These are the craftsmen, the builders and the masons. They are also to buy wood and cut stone to repair the temple.

es.L: a los artesanos, y a los constructores y a los albañiles, y para comprar madera y piedras labradas para reparar la casa.
es.B: a los artesanos, los constructores y los albañiles, y que compren madera y piedra labrada para reparar la casa.
es.R: Estos trabajadores son los artesanos, los constructores y los albañiles. También tienen que comprar madera y piedra cortada para reparar el templo.

fr.L: aux artisans, aux bâtisseurs et aux maçons, et pour acheter du bois et des pierres de taille pour réparer la maison.
fr.B: les artisans, les bâtisseurs et les maçons, et qu’on achète du bois et des pierres taillées pour réparer la maison.
fr.R: Ce sont les artisans, les bâtisseurs et les maçons. Il faut aussi acheter du bois et des pierres taillées pour réparer le temple.

sw.L: kwa mafundi na kwa wajenzi na kwa waashi, na kununua miti na mawe ya kuchonga ili kuitengeneza nyumba.
sw.B: yaani mafundi, wajenzi na waashi, na wanunue miti na mawe yaliyochongwa ili kuitengeneza nyumba.
sw.R: Hao ni mafundi, wajenzi na waashi. Pia wanunue mbao na mawe yaliyochongwa ili kulitengeneza hekalu.

vi.L: cho thợ mộc, thợ xây và thợ nề, và để mua gỗ và đá đẽo mà sửa chữa nhà.
vi.B: tức là thợ mộc, thợ xây và thợ nề, và để mua gỗ và đá đẽo sửa chữa nhà.
vi.R: Đó là thợ mộc, thợ xây và thợ nề. Họ cũng sẽ mua gỗ và đá đã đẽo để sửa chữa đền thờ.

ko.L: 곧 목수들과 건축하는 자들과 석수들에게 [주고], 또 그 집을 고칠 목재와 다듬은 돌을 사게 하여라.
ko.B: 곧 목수와 건축자와 석수들에게 주고, 그 집을 수리할 목재와 다듬은 돌도 사게 하여라.
ko.R: 그 일꾼들은 목수와 건축자와 석수들이다. 감독들은 또 성전을 고치는 데 쓸 나무와 깎은 돌을 사야 한다.

decisions.choice: craftsmen, builders and masons: the workmen paid with the money
decisions.reason: The first word means skilled workers in wood, stone or metal; in 12:12 they are called craftsmen of wood. The last word is from a verb meaning to build a wall, as in 12:13: the men who laid the stone.

decisions.choice: timber and hewn stones: as in 12:13
decisions.reason: The same materials were bought for the repairs under Jehoash (12:13): wood and stone cut and shaped at the quarry (1 Kings 5:31).

decisions.choice: craftsmen; hewn stones (Literal); dressed stone (Balanced); cut stone (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording of 12:13 where the Hebrew is the same. Readable makes the list its own sentence and closes the king's orders with "They are also to buy".

source.text: אַ֚ךְ לֹא־יֵחָשֵׁ֣ב אִתָּ֔ם הַכֶּ֖סֶף הַנִּתָּ֣ן עַל־יָדָ֑ם כִּ֥י בֶאֱמוּנָ֖ה הֵ֥ם עֹשִֽׂים׃

records.literal_gloss: Only not will be reckoned with them the money given on their hand, for in faithfulness they [are] acting.

en.L: Only, the money that is given into their hand shall not be reckoned with them, for they act in faithfulness."
en.B: But no accounting is to be asked of them for the money handed to them, because they deal honestly."
en.R: Do not ask them to give an account of the money they receive, because they are honest."

es.L: Solo que no se les pida cuenta del dinero que se les entrega en su mano, porque proceden con fidelidad».
es.B: Pero que no se les pida cuenta del dinero que se les entrega, porque actúan con honradez».
es.R: No les pidas cuentas del dinero que reciben, porque son honrados».

fr.L: Seulement, on ne leur demandera pas de compte de l’argent remis entre leurs mains, car ils agissent avec fidélité. »
fr.B: Mais on ne leur demandera aucun compte de l’argent qu’on leur remet, car ils agissent avec honnêteté. »
fr.R: Ne leur demande pas de rendre compte de l’argent qu’ils reçoivent, parce qu’ils sont honnêtes. »

sw.L: Ila fedha inayotiwa mkononi mwao isihesabiwe pamoja nao, kwa maana wanatenda kwa uaminifu."
sw.B: Lakini wasitakiwe kutoa hesabu ya fedha wanayokabidhiwa, kwa sababu wanafanya kazi kwa uaminifu."
sw.R: Usiwaambie watoe hesabu ya fedha wanazopokea, kwa sababu ni waaminifu."

vi.L: Chỉ có điều, bạc giao vào tay họ thì không cần tính sổ với họ, vì họ làm việc trung tín."
vi.B: Nhưng đừng bắt họ khai trình số bạc đã giao cho họ, vì họ làm việc ngay thẳng."
vi.R: Đừng bắt họ báo cáo về số bạc họ nhận, vì họ là người trung thực."

ko.L: 다만 그들의 손에 넘겨준 돈을 그들과 셈하지 마라. 그들이 진실하게 일하기 때문이다."
ko.B: 그들에게 넘겨준 돈에 대해서는 셈을 따지지 마라. 그들은 정직하게 일하는 사람들이다."
ko.R: 그들이 받은 돈을 어디에 썼는지 따지지 마라. 그들은 정직한 사람들이다."

decisions.choice: they act in faithfulness: the words said of the overseers under Jehoash
decisions.reason: 12:16 says the same of the men who paid the workmen in Jehoash's day: no one checked their accounts, "for they acted in faithfulness". Here the words are part of the king's orders.

decisions.choice: not reckoned with them ... in faithfulness: no accounts asked, because they are honest
decisions.reason: The verb means to count or reckon, here to call for an account of how money was spent. The noun means steadiness and reliability: these men could be trusted with the money.

decisions.choice: the king's orders end here
decisions.reason: The verse is still part of what the king tells Shaphan to say. "Them" are the overseers who receive the money (verse 5).

decisions.choice: they act in faithfulness / they deal honestly / they are honest
decisions.reason: The wording of 12:16 at each level, in the present tense because here it is the king speaking.

source.text: וַ֠יֹּאמֶר חִלְקִיָּ֜הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֤ן הַגָּדוֹל֙ עַל־שָׁפָ֣ן הַסֹּפֵ֔ר סֵ֧פֶר הַתּוֹרָ֛ה מָצָ֖אתִי בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּתֵּ֨ן חִלְקִיָּ֧ה אֶת־הַסֵּ֛פֶר אֶל־שָׁפָ֖ן וַיִּקְרָאֵֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Hilkiah the priest the great to Shaphan the scribe, [the] book of the law I have found in [the] house of Yahweh; and gave Hilkiah the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

en.L: And Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe, "The book of the law I have found in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}." And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.
en.B: Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the secretary, "In the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} I have found the book of the law." Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.
en.R: Hilkiah the high priest told Shaphan the secretary, "I have found the book of {{divine_name:the LORD's|Yahweh's}} teaching in the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}." He gave the book to Shaphan, and Shaphan read it.

es.L: Y el sumo sacerdote Hilcías dijo al escriba Safán: «El libro de la ley he hallado en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}». E Hilcías dio el libro a Safán, y él lo leyó.
es.B: El sumo sacerdote Hilcías le dijo al secretario Safán: «En la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} he encontrado el libro de la ley». Hilcías le dio el libro a Safán, y él lo leyó.
es.R: El sumo sacerdote Hilcías le dijo al secretario Safán: «He encontrado en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} el libro de la enseñanza {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}». Le dio el libro a Safán, y Safán lo leyó.

fr.L: Et Hilqiya, le grand prêtre, dit à Shaphân le scribe : « J’ai trouvé le livre de la Loi dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. » Et Hilqiya donna le livre à Shaphân, et il le lut.
fr.B: Hilqiya, le grand prêtre, dit à Shaphân, le secrétaire : « J’ai trouvé le livre de la Loi dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. » Hilqiya donna le livre à Shaphân, qui le lut.
fr.R: Hilqiya, le grand prêtre, a dit à Shaphân, le secrétaire : « J’ai trouvé le livre de l’enseignement {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. » Il a donné le livre à Shaphân, et Shaphân l’a lu.

sw.L: Naye Hilkia kuhani mkuu akamwambia Shafani mwandishi, "Kitabu cha Sheria nimekiona katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}." Naye Hilkia akampa Shafani kitabu, naye akakisoma.
sw.B: Hilkia kuhani mkuu akamwambia Shafani katibu, "Katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} nimekiona kitabu cha Sheria." Hilkia akampa Shafani kitabu hicho, naye akakisoma.
sw.R: Hilkia kuhani mkuu akamwambia Shafani katibu, "Nimekiona kitabu cha mafundisho ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}." Akampa Shafani kitabu hicho, naye Shafani akakisoma.

vi.L: Thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm Hinh-kia nói với thư ký Sa-phan: "Sách Luật Pháp, tôi đã tìm thấy trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}." Hinh-kia đưa sách cho Sa-phan, và ông đọc nó.
vi.B: Thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm Hinh-kia nói với thư ký Sa-phan: "Tôi đã tìm thấy sách Luật Pháp trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}." Hinh-kia đưa sách cho Sa-phan, và Sa-phan đọc.
vi.R: Thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm Hinh-kia nói với thư ký Sa-phan: "Tôi đã tìm thấy sách chứa lời dạy của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}." Ông đưa sách cho Sa-phan, và Sa-phan đọc sách ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 대제사장 힐기야가 서기관 사반에게 말했다. "율법책을 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 찾았소." 그리고 힐기야가 그 책을 사반에게 주었고, 그가 그것을 읽었다.
ko.B: 대제사장 힐기야가 서기관 사반에게 말했다. "내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 율법책을 찾았소." 힐기야가 그 책을 사반에게 주자, 사반이 그것을 읽었다.
ko.R: 대제사장 힐기야가 서기관 사반에게 말했다. "내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 가르침을 적은 책을 찾았소." 그는 그 책을 사반에게 주었고, 사반은 그것을 읽었다.

decisions.choice: the book of the law: the book of Yahweh's instruction
decisions.reason: The word for "law" (torah) means instruction or teaching, the whole of what Yahweh taught through Moses, not only rules (Deuteronomy 1:5; 31:9). 2 Chronicles 34:14 calls it "the book of the law of Yahweh given through Moses".

decisions.choice: the book is usually identified with Deuteronomy, or its core
alternatives: a part of Deuteronomy, such as chapters 12-26 and 28
decisions.reason: The book is not named further, but what it leads Josiah to do matches Deuteronomy closely: worship at one place only (23:8-9; Deuteronomy 12), the removal of mediums and of sacred pillars and poles (23:14, 24; Deuteronomy 16:21-22; 18:10-11), the Passover kept at the chosen place (23:21-23; Deuteronomy 16:1-8) and the curses that alarm the king (verses 11-13; Deuteronomy 28). Deuteronomy itself calls itself "this book of the law" and was to be kept beside the ark (Deuteronomy 31:24-26). It may also have been the whole five books of Moses or a part of Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: I have found the book: a scroll that had been lost or neglected
decisions.reason: A "book" was a scroll. The text does not say how it came to be lost; under Manasseh and Amon the temple had been given over to other gods for some fifty-five years (21:1-7, 19-22), and the scroll may have lain unused, or come to light during the repairs.

decisions.choice: the book of the LORD's teaching (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says "teaching" for torah, as in Deuteronomy, because "law" alone makes most readers think only of rules (m1). It adds whose teaching it is, as 2 Chronicles 34:14 does, so the reader does not take it for a book of human laws. Literal and Balanced keep "the book of the law".

decisions.choice: "el libro de la ley" (L, B); "el libro de la enseñanza del SEÑOR" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "el libro de la ley", as the terms note's "el libro de la Ley" and the English do; Readable says "enseñanza", as the published Spanish does for torah, so that it is not read as a legal code.

decisions.choice: "le livre de la Loi" (L, B); "le livre de l'enseignement du SEIGNEUR" (R)
decisions.reason: The book of the Law of Moses takes the capital as the terms note sets; Readable says what the book was, as the English does.

decisions.choice: kitabu cha Sheria (Literal, Balanced); kitabu cha mafundisho ya BWANA (Readable)
decisions.reason: The book of the Law in the terms note's wording; Readable calls it "the book of the LORD's teaching", as the English does.

decisions.choice: sách Luật Pháp (L, B); sách chứa lời dạy của CHÚA (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note sets "sách Luật Pháp" for the book of the Law; Readable says "lời dạy" for torah, as the English says "teaching".

decisions.choice: "율법책" (L, B); "주의 가르침을 적은 책" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's word for the book of the Law; Readable says what *torah* is, as the English Readable says "the LORD's teaching".

decisions.choice: Hilkiah and Shaphan speak to each other in 하오체
decisions.reason: Two senior officials of rank speaking as equals; 하오체 keeps them courteous without either deferring to the other.

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֞א שָׁפָ֤ן הַסֹּפֵר֙ אֶל־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיָּ֥שֶׁב אֶת־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ דָּבָ֑ר וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הִתִּ֤יכוּ עֲבָדֶ֨יךָ֙ אֶת־הַכֶּ֨סֶף֙ הַנִּמְצָ֣א בַבַּ֔יִת וַֽיִּתְּנֻ֗הוּ עַל־יַד֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה הַמֻּפְקָדִ֖ים בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And came Shaphan the scribe to the king, and he brought back [to] the king word, and he said, have poured out your servants the money found in the house, and they have given it on [the] hand of [the] doers of the work, those appointed [in the] house of Yahweh.

en.L: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought back word to the king, and he said, "Your servants have poured out the money that was found in the house, and they have given it into [the] hand of the doers of the work, who are appointed in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.B: Shaphan the secretary went to the king and reported to him, "Your officials have emptied out the money found in the house and handed it over to the men doing the work, who have been put in charge of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.R: Shaphan the secretary went to the king and reported, "Your officials have emptied out the money that was found in the temple. They have given it to the men in charge of the work on the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."

es.L: Y vino el escriba Safán al rey, y le llevó respuesta al rey, y dijo: «Tus siervos han vaciado el dinero que se halló en la casa, y lo han entregado en mano de los que hacen la obra, los encargados en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}».
es.B: El secretario Safán fue a ver al rey y le informó: «Tus funcionarios han vaciado el dinero que había en la casa y se lo han entregado a los que hacen la obra, los encargados de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}».
es.R: El secretario Safán fue a ver al rey y le informó: «Tus funcionarios han sacado el dinero que había en el templo. Se lo han dado a los hombres encargados de la obra del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}».

fr.L: Et Shaphân le scribe vint auprès du roi et rapporta au roi une parole ; il dit : « Tes serviteurs ont versé l’argent qui se trouvait dans la maison, et ils l’ont remis entre les mains de ceux qui font l’ouvrage, qui sont préposés à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. »
fr.B: Shaphân, le secrétaire, alla trouver le roi et lui rendit compte : « Tes officiers ont vidé l’argent qui se trouvait dans la maison et l’ont remis aux responsables des travaux, chargés de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. »
fr.R: Shaphân, le secrétaire, est allé voir le roi et il lui a fait son rapport : « Tes officiers ont vidé le coffre de l’argent qui se trouvait dans le temple. Ils l’ont donné aux hommes chargés des travaux du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. »

sw.L: Naye Shafani mwandishi akaja kwa mfalme, akamletea mfalme habari, akasema, "Watumishi wako wameimimina fedha iliyoonekana ndani ya nyumba, nao wameitia katika mkono wa watendaji wa kazi, walioteuliwa katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.B: Shafani katibu alikwenda kwa mfalme, akampa taarifa: "Maafisa wako wameimimina fedha iliyopatikana ndani ya nyumba, nao wameikabidhi kwa watu wanaofanya kazi, waliowekwa kuisimamia nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.R: Shafani katibu alikwenda kwa mfalme, akampa taarifa: "Maafisa wako wameitoa fedha iliyokuwa hekaluni. Wamewapa watu wanaosimamia kazi ya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."

vi.L: Thư ký Sa-phan đến cùng vua, tâu trình lại với vua rằng: "Các đầy tớ của vua đã đổ ra số bạc tìm thấy trong nhà, và đã giao vào tay những người làm công việc, là những người được giao coi sóc nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."
vi.B: Thư ký Sa-phan đến tâu với vua: "Các triều thần của bệ hạ đã lấy ra số bạc tìm thấy trong đền thờ và đã giao cho những người phụ trách công việc, là những người được giao coi sóc nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."
vi.R: Thư ký Sa-phan đến tâu với vua: "Các quan chức của đức vua đã lấy hết số bạc có trong đền thờ. Họ đã giao số bạc ấy cho những người trông coi công việc ở đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."

ko.L: 그리고 서기관 사반이 왕에게 와서 왕에게 보고하여 말했다. "임금님의 종들이 성전에서 발견된 돈을 쏟아 내어, 그것을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 임명된, 일하는 자들의 손에 넘겨주었습니다."
ko.B: 서기관 사반이 왕에게 가서 보고했다. "임금님의 신하들이 성전에 있던 돈을 쏟아 내어, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 공사를 맡은 감독들에게 넘겨주었습니다."
ko.R: 서기관 사반은 왕에게 가서 이렇게 보고했다. "임금님의 신하들이 성전에 있던 돈을 꺼냈습니다. 그리고 그 돈을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 공사를 맡은 감독들에게 주었습니다."

decisions.choice: poured out the money: emptied the chest
decisions.reason: The verb means to pour out. Here it most likely means that the officials emptied the money out of the chest (12:10-11) to be weighed and paid out. The same verb is used of melting metal in a furnace (Ezekiel 22:20-22), so it may mean that the silver was melted down into bars.

decisions.choice: brought back word to the king: reported to him
decisions.reason: To bring back a word is to give a report on a task one was sent to do. Shaphan reports the money first; only then does he speak of the book (verse 10).

decisions.choice: your servants: the king's officials who handled the money
decisions.reason: Shaphan speaks of the men who carried out the king's order as the king's servants, his officials, not household slaves.

decisions.choice: your officials (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The king's servants are "officials" at Balanced and Readable, as throughout these books; Literal keeps "servants".

decisions.choice: đầy tớ của vua (L); triều thần của bệ hạ (B); quan chức của đức vua (R)
decisions.reason: Shaphan addresses Josiah as subjects do, "vua" (L), "bệ hạ" (B), "đức vua" (R), as the terms note sets.

source.text: וַיַּגֵּ֞ד שָׁפָ֤ן הַסֹּפֵר֙ לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ לֵאמֹ֔ר סֵ֚פֶר נָ֣תַן לִ֔י חִלְקִיָּ֖ה הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וַיִּקְרָאֵ֥הוּ שָׁפָ֖ן לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And told Shaphan the scribe to the king, saying, [a] book has given to me Hilkiah the priest; and read it Shaphan before the king.

en.L: And Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, "A book Hilkiah the priest has given me." And Shaphan read it before the king.
en.B: Then Shaphan the secretary told the king, "Hilkiah the priest has handed me a book." And Shaphan read it aloud to the king.
en.R: Shaphan the secretary also told the king, "Hilkiah the priest gave me a book." Then he read it aloud to the king.

es.L: Y el escriba Safán informó al rey, diciendo: «Un libro me ha dado el sacerdote Hilcías». Y Safán lo leyó delante del rey.
es.B: Luego el secretario Safán le dijo al rey: «El sacerdote Hilcías me ha entregado un libro». Y Safán lo leyó en voz alta ante el rey.
es.R: El secretario Safán también le dijo al rey: «El sacerdote Hilcías me dio un libro». Luego se lo leyó en voz alta al rey.

fr.L: Et Shaphân le scribe informa le roi en disant : « Le prêtre Hilqiya m’a donné un livre. » Et Shaphân le lut devant le roi.
fr.B: Puis Shaphân, le secrétaire, annonça au roi : « Le prêtre Hilqiya m’a remis un livre. » Et Shaphân le lut à haute voix devant le roi.
fr.R: Shaphân, le secrétaire, a aussi dit au roi : « Le prêtre Hilqiya m’a donné un livre. » Ensuite il l’a lu à haute voix au roi.

sw.L: Naye Shafani mwandishi akamweleza mfalme, akisema, "Kitabu Hilkia kuhani amenipa." Naye Shafani akakisoma mbele ya mfalme.
sw.B: Kisha Shafani katibu akamwambia mfalme, "Hilkia kuhani amenipa kitabu." Naye Shafani akakisoma kwa sauti mbele ya mfalme.
sw.R: Shafani katibu alimwambia mfalme pia, "Hilkia kuhani amenipa kitabu." Kisha akamsomea mfalme kwa sauti.

vi.L: Thư ký Sa-phan cũng tâu với vua rằng: "Thầy tế lễ Hinh-kia đã đưa cho tôi một cuốn sách." Rồi Sa-phan đọc sách ấy trước mặt vua.
vi.B: Rồi thư ký Sa-phan tâu với vua: "Thầy tế lễ Hinh-kia đã trao cho tôi một cuốn sách." Và Sa-phan đọc lớn sách ấy cho vua nghe.
vi.R: Thư ký Sa-phan cũng tâu với vua: "Thầy tế lễ Hinh-kia đã đưa cho tôi một cuốn sách." Rồi ông đọc lớn sách ấy cho vua nghe.

ko.L: 그리고 서기관 사반이 왕에게 알려 말했다. "제사장 힐기야가 저에게 책 한 권을 주었습니다." 그리고 사반이 왕 앞에서 그것을 읽었다.
ko.B: 그리고 서기관 사반이 왕에게 말했다. "제사장 힐기야가 저에게 책 한 권을 건네주었습니다." 그러고는 사반이 그것을 왕 앞에서 소리 내어 읽었다.
ko.R: 서기관 사반은 또 왕에게 말했다. "제사장 힐기야가 저에게 책 한 권을 주었습니다." 그러고 나서 사반은 그 책을 왕에게 소리 내어 읽어 주었다.

decisions.choice: a book: Shaphan names it without saying what it is
decisions.reason: "A book" stands first in Shaphan's words. He does not repeat Hilkiah's words "the book of the law" (verse 8); the king learns what it is by hearing it read.

decisions.choice: read it before the king: read it aloud to him
decisions.reason: Reading was usually done aloud, and to read "before" someone is to read in his hearing (Deuteronomy 31:11). 2 Chronicles 34:18 says that Shaphan "read in it", which may mean he read parts of it.

decisions.choice: aloud
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "aloud" for what reading "before the king" means (m2).

source.text: וַֽיְהִי֙ כִּשְׁמֹ֣עַ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֖י סֵ֣פֶר הַתּוֹרָ֑ה וַיִּקְרַ֖ע אֶת־בְּגָדָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was when heard the king the words of [the] book of the law, and he tore his clothes.

en.L: And it was, when the king heard the words of the book of the law, that he tore his clothes.
en.B: When the king heard the words written in the book of the law, he tore his clothes.
en.R: When the king heard the words of the book of {{divine_name:the LORD's|Yahweh's}} teaching, he tore his clothes in grief.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando el rey oyó las palabras del libro de la ley, rasgó sus vestidos.
es.B: Cuando el rey oyó las palabras escritas en el libro de la ley, rasgó sus vestidos.
es.R: Cuando el rey oyó las palabras del libro de la enseñanza {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, rasgó su ropa en señal de dolor.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand le roi entendit les paroles du livre de la Loi, qu’il déchira ses vêtements.
fr.B: Quand le roi entendit les paroles écrites dans le livre de la Loi, il déchira ses vêtements.
fr.R: Quand le roi a entendu les paroles du livre de l’enseignement {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, il a déchiré ses vêtements de douleur.

sw.L: Ikawa mfalme alipoyasikia maneno ya kitabu cha Sheria, akayararua mavazi yake.
sw.B: Mfalme alipoyasikia maneno yaliyoandikwa katika kitabu cha Sheria, aliyararua mavazi yake.
sw.R: Mfalme alipoyasikia maneno ya kitabu cha mafundisho ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliyararua mavazi yake kwa huzuni.

vi.L: Xảy ra, khi vua nghe những lời của sách Luật Pháp, thì vua xé áo mình.
vi.B: Khi vua nghe những lời chép trong sách Luật Pháp, vua xé áo mình.
vi.R: Khi vua nghe những lời trong sách chứa lời dạy của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vua xé áo mình vì đau buồn.

ko.L: 그리고 왕이 율법책의 말씀을 들었을 때에 자기 옷을 찢었다.
ko.B: 왕은 율법책에 기록된 말씀을 듣고 자기 옷을 찢었다.
ko.R: 왕은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 가르침을 적은 책의 말씀을 듣고, 슬퍼하며 자기 옷을 찢었다.

decisions.choice: he tore his clothes: a sign of grief and alarm
decisions.reason: Tearing one's clothes was the outward sign of grief, dismay or repentance (18:37; 19:1; 1 Kings 21:27). The king sees that the words of the book stand against his people (verse 13).

decisions.choice: the words of the book of the law: what was written in it
decisions.reason: The narrator now names the book as Hilkiah did (verse 8). The words are its commands and its warnings (verse 13).

decisions.choice: in grief (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable adds "in grief" to say what tearing the clothes meant (m1). It says "the book of the LORD's teaching" as in verse 8.

source.text: וַיְצַ֣ו הַמֶּ֡לֶךְ אֶת־חִלְקִיָּ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֡ן וְאֶת־אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן־שָׁ֠פָן וְאֶת־עַכְבּ֨וֹר בֶּן־מִיכָיָ֜ה וְאֵ֣ת׀שָׁפָ֣ן הַסֹּפֵ֗ר וְאֵ֛ת עֲשָׂיָ֥ה עֶֽבֶד־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ לֵאמֹֽר׃

en.L: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest and Ahikam son of Shaphan and Achbor son of Micaiah and Shaphan the scribe and Asaiah the servant of the king, saying,
en.B: Then the king gave orders to Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Achbor son of Micaiah, Shaphan the secretary and Asaiah the king's official,
en.R: Then the king gave an order to Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Achbor son of Micaiah, Shaphan the secretary, and Asaiah, an official of the king. He said,

es.B: Entonces el rey dio órdenes al sacerdote Hilcías, a Ahicam hijo de Safán, a Acbor hijo de Micaías, al secretario Safán y a Asaías, funcionario del rey:

decisions.choice: Ahikam son of Shaphan; Achbor son of Micaiah
decisions.reason: Ahikam was the son of Shaphan the secretary. He later protected the prophet Jeremiah (Jeremiah 26:24), and his son Gedaliah was made governor of Judah after the fall of Jerusalem (25:22). Achbor's son Elnathan was one of the officials under Jehoiakim (Jeremiah 26:22; 36:12).

decisions.choice: Achbor son of Micaiah: called Abdon son of Micah in Chronicles
decisions.reason: 2 Chronicles 34:20 names him Abdon son of Micah. Micah is a short form of Micaiah; the two forms of the first name may come from different ways of writing it down.

decisions.choice: Asaiah the servant of the king: a title for a royal official
decisions.reason: "Servant of the king" was the title of a high officer serving the king directly, not a household slave (25:8 uses the same words of a Babylonian officer).

decisions.choice: the sentence goes on into verse 13
decisions.reason: "Saying" introduces the king's command, given in verse 13.

decisions.choice: the king's official (Balanced); an official of the king (Readable)
decisions.reason: The king's servant is an "official" at Balanced and Readable, as throughout these books; Literal keeps "servant".

decisions.choice: "Ahicam", "Acbor", "Micaías", "Asaías"; "siervo del rey" (L); "funcionario del rey" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The names in their usual Spanish forms; the king's servant is an official at Balanced and Readable, as these books set.

records.literal_gloss: Go, inquire of Yahweh for me and for the people and for all Judah concerning [the] words of the book the found the this; for great [is] [the] wrath of Yahweh which it has been kindled against us, because that not listened our fathers to [the] words of the book the this, to do according to all the written concerning us.

en.L: "Go, inquire of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for me and for the people and for all Judah concerning the words of this book that has been found; for great [is] the wrath of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that has been kindled against us, because our fathers did not listen to the words of this book, to do according to all that is written concerning us."
en.B: "Go and ask {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} on my behalf, and on behalf of the people and all Judah, about the words of this book that has been found. {{divine_name:The LORD's|Yahweh's}} anger burns hot against us, because our ancestors did not listen to the words of this book or do all that it lays down for us."
en.R: "Go and ask {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} about the words of this book that has been found. Ask for me, for the people and for all Judah. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is very angry with us, because our ancestors did not obey the words of this book. They did not do what it tells us to do."

No hicieron lo que nos dice que hagamos».

fr.L: « Allez, consultez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pour moi, et pour le peuple, et pour tout Juda, au sujet des paroles de ce livre qui a été trouvé ; car grande [est] la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qui s’est enflammée contre nous, parce que nos pères n’ont pas écouté les paroles de ce livre, pour agir selon tout ce qui est écrit à notre sujet. »

Ils n’ont pas fait ce qu’il nous dit de faire. »

sw.L: "Nendeni, mkamwulize {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa ajili yangu na kwa ajili ya watu na kwa ajili ya Yuda wote kuhusu maneno ya kitabu hiki kilichoonekana; kwa maana ni kubwa ghadhabu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} iliyowashwa juu yetu, kwa sababu baba zetu hawakuyasikiliza maneno ya kitabu hiki, kufanya sawasawa na yote yaliyoandikwa kutuhusu."

Hawakufanya yale kinayotuambia tufanye."

ko.L: "가서, 이 발견된 책의 말씀에 대하여 나와 백성과 온 유다를 위하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 여쭈어라. 우리를 향하여 불붙은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 진노가 크다. 이는 우리 조상들이 이 책의 말씀을 듣지 않고, 우리에 대하여 기록된 모든 것대로 행하지 않았기 때문이다."
ko.B: "가서, 이번에 발견된 이 책의 말씀에 대하여 나와 백성과 온 유다를 위하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 여쭈어라. 우리 조상들이 이 책의 말씀을 듣지 않고 거기에 우리에게 명령된 대로 행하지 않았으므로, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리에게 크게 진노하셨다."

decisions.choice: inquire of Yahweh: seek a word from Yahweh through a prophet
decisions.reason: To "seek" Yahweh in this sense is to ask for his answer on a matter, usually through a prophet (1 Kings 22:7-8; 2 Kings 3:11). The officials go to Huldah (verse 14).

decisions.choice: great is the wrath of Yahweh that has been kindled: his anger burns
decisions.reason: The noun is a strong word for burning anger, and the verb pictures it set alight like a fire. Huldah's answer takes up the same picture (verse 17).

decisions.choice: all that is written concerning us: what the book lays on us
decisions.reason: The words can mean what the book requires of Israel, or what it writes against them, its curses (Deuteronomy 28:15-68). The king fears both: the commands were not kept, and so the curses stand.

decisions.choice: our ancestors
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "ancestors" for "fathers", the generations before; Literal keeps "fathers".

decisions.choice: the people for whom they ask placed in a second sentence (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable splits the long command into short sentences and says "obey" for "listen to", the sense the verb has with a command.

decisions.choice: "consultar al SEÑOR"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note sets for "inquire of the LORD"; the king sends the five men together, so the commands carry the plural_you setting.

decisions.choice: "consultez le SEIGNEUR" (L, B); "interrogez le SEIGNEUR" (R)
decisions.reason: "Consulter le SEIGNEUR" as the Samuel terms note sets for seeking a word from him through a prophet (m1).

records.literal_gloss: And went Hilkiah the priest and Ahikam and Achbor and Shaphan and Asaiah to Huldah the prophetess, [the] wife of Shallum son of Tikvah son of Harhas, keeper of the garments, and she [was] living in Jerusalem in the Second [Quarter]; and they spoke to her.

en.L: And Hilkiah the priest and Ahikam and Achbor and Shaphan and Asaiah went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum son of Tikvah, son of Harhas, keeper of the garments; and she [was] living in Jerusalem in the Second [Quarter]; and they spoke to her.
en.B: So Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan and Asaiah went to the prophet Huldah, the wife of Shallum son of Tikvah, son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe. Her home was in the Second Quarter of Jerusalem, and they spoke with her.
en.R: So Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan and Asaiah went to speak with Huldah. She was a prophet. Her husband was Shallum son of Tikvah, son of Harhas, the man in charge of the wardrobe. She lived in the newer part of Jerusalem called the Second Quarter.

es.L: Y fueron el sacerdote Hilcías, y Ahicam, y Acbor, y Safán y Asaías a la profetisa Hulda, mujer de Salum hijo de Ticva, hijo de Harhas, guarda de las vestiduras; y ella habitaba en Jerusalén, en el Segundo [Barrio]; y hablaron con ella.
es.B: Así que el sacerdote Hilcías, Ahicam, Acbor, Safán y Asaías fueron a ver a la profetisa Hulda, esposa de Salum hijo de Ticva, hijo de Harhas, encargado del vestuario. Ella vivía en el Segundo Barrio de Jerusalén, y hablaron con ella.
es.R: Entonces el sacerdote Hilcías, Ahicam, Acbor, Safán y Asaías fueron a hablar con Hulda. Ella era profetisa. Su esposo era Salum hijo de Ticva, hijo de Harhas, el encargado del vestuario. Ella vivía en la parte nueva de Jerusalén llamada el Segundo Barrio.

fr.L: Et le prêtre Hilqiya, Ahiqam, Akbor, Shaphân et Asaya allèrent auprès de Houlda la prophétesse, femme de Shalloum fils de Tiqva, fils de Harhas, gardien des vêtements ; elle habitait à Jérusalem dans le second [quartier] ; et ils lui parlèrent.
fr.B: Le prêtre Hilqiya, Ahiqam, Akbor, Shaphân et Asaya allèrent donc trouver la prophétesse Houlda, femme de Shalloum, fils de Tiqva, fils de Harhas, le gardien de la garde-robe. Elle habitait à Jérusalem, dans le second quartier, et ils lui parlèrent.
fr.R: Alors le prêtre Hilqiya, Ahiqam, Akbor, Shaphân et Asaya sont allés parler avec Houlda. C’était une prophétesse. Son mari était Shalloum fils de Tiqva, fils de Harhas, l’homme chargé de la garde-robe. Elle habitait dans la partie nouvelle de Jérusalem, qu’on appelait le second quartier.

sw.L: Basi Hilkia kuhani, na Ahikamu, na Akbori, na Shafani, na Asaya wakaenda kwa Hulda nabii mke, mke wa Shalumu mwana wa Tikva, mwana wa Harhasi, mtunzaji wa mavazi; naye alikuwa akikaa Yerusalemu katika [Mtaa wa] Pili; wakasema naye.
sw.B: Basi Hilkia kuhani, Ahikamu, Akbori, Shafani na Asaya walikwenda kwa nabii Hulda, mke wa Shalumu mwana wa Tikva, mwana wa Harhasi, mtunzaji wa mavazi. Aliishi katika Mtaa wa Pili wa Yerusalemu, nao wakazungumza naye.
sw.R: Basi Hilkia kuhani, Ahikamu, Akbori, Shafani na Asaya walikwenda kuzungumza na Hulda. Yeye alikuwa nabii. Mumewe alikuwa Shalumu mwana wa Tikva, mwana wa Harhasi, msimamizi wa mavazi. Hulda aliishi katika sehemu mpya ya Yerusalemu iliyoitwa Mtaa wa Pili.

vi.L: Thầy tế lễ Hinh-kia, A-hi-cam, Ạc-bồ, Sa-phan và A-sa-gia đi đến nữ tiên tri Hun-đa, vợ của Sa-lum con trai Tích-va, con trai Hạt-ha, người giữ áo xống; bà ở tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, trong Khu Thứ Hai; và họ nói chuyện với bà.
vi.B: Vậy thầy tế lễ Hinh-kia, A-hi-cam, Ạc-bồ, Sa-phan và A-sa-gia đi đến gặp nhà tiên tri Hun-đa, vợ của Sa-lum con trai Tích-va, cháu Hạt-ha, người giữ kho áo lễ. Bà sống tại Khu Thứ Hai của Giê-ru-sa-lem, và họ trình bày với bà.
vi.R: Vậy thầy tế lễ Hinh-kia, A-hi-cam, Ạc-bồ, Sa-phan và A-sa-gia đi đến nói chuyện với Hun-đa. Bà là một nhà tiên tri. Chồng bà là Sa-lum con trai Tích-va, cháu Hạt-ha, người trông coi kho áo lễ. Bà sống ở khu mới của Giê-ru-sa-lem gọi là Khu Thứ Hai.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장 힐기야와 아히감과 악볼과 사반과 아사야가 여예언자 훌다에게 갔다. 그녀는 할하스의 손자 디과의 아들인 예복을 맡은 자 살룸의 아내였다. 그녀는 예루살렘 둘째 구역에 살고 있었다. 그리고 그들이 그녀에게 말했다.
ko.B: 그래서 제사장 힐기야와 아히감과 악볼과 사반과 아사야는 예언자 훌다에게 갔다. 그녀는 할하스의 손자요 디과의 아들인 예복 관리인 살룸의 아내였는데, 예루살렘 둘째 구역에 살고 있었다. 그들이 그녀와 이야기를 나누었다.
ko.R: 그래서 제사장 힐기야와 아히감과 악볼과 사반과 아사야는 훌다에게 이야기하러 갔다. 훌다는 예언자였다. 그녀의 남편은 예복을 맡아 관리하는 살룸이었다. 살룸은 디과의 아들이고 할하스의 손자였다. 훌다는 예루살렘에서 새로 생긴 둘째 구역에 살고 있었다.

decisions.choice: Huldah the prophetess: a woman who spoke Yahweh's word
decisions.reason: The noun is the feminine form of the word for "prophet", used also of Miriam (Exodus 15:20) and Deborah (Judges 4:4). The king's officials, the high priest among them, go to her for Yahweh's answer.

decisions.choice: keeper of the garments: in charge of a wardrobe, royal or priestly
decisions.reason: Shallum looked after a store of clothing. It may have been the king's wardrobe or the vestments kept for the temple (10:22 speaks of the one in charge of the vestments in the temple of Baal); the text does not say which.

decisions.choice: the Second Quarter: a newer district of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The word means "second" or "double". Here it most likely names a part of the city added later, outside the oldest walls, probably on the western hill (Zephaniah 1:11; Nehemiah 11:9 speaks of one "second over the city"). Where exactly it lay is not certain; an older understanding took it to mean a school or college.

decisions.choice: Shallum son of Tikvah son of Harhas: named a little differently in Chronicles
decisions.reason: 2 Chronicles 34:22 names Huldah's husband Shallum son of Tokhath son of Hasrah. The names are close in form and most likely spellings of the same names.

decisions.choice: the prophet (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: English now uses "prophet" for women and men alike, as at Judges 4:4; Literal keeps "prophetess". "Wardrobe" at Balanced and Readable names what "the garments" are.

decisions.choice: the newer part of the city called the Second Quarter (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable explains the district's name (m3) and splits the description into short sentences.

decisions.choice: "profetisa" at every level; "el Segundo Barrio"
decisions.reason: Spanish "profetisa" is the ordinary word for a woman prophet, so it stays at every level where English Balanced and Readable say "prophet"; "Hulda" as the terms note's table gives it.

decisions.choice: "la prophétesse" at every level
decisions.reason: French has a common feminine form, "prophétesse", which says she was a prophet without the awkwardness of the English choice; Houlda is the terms note's form.

decisions.choice: nabii mke (Literal); nabii (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has a feminine form of "prophet"; Swahili "nabii" serves for women and men, so Balanced and Readable say "nabii", as the English says "prophet".

decisions.choice: nữ tiên tri (L); nhà tiên tri (B, R); bà
decisions.reason: Literal marks the feminine form as the Hebrew does; Balanced and Readable say "nhà tiên tri", the same word as for men, as the English does. The narrator and the king's men call her "bà".

decisions.choice: "여예언자" (L); "예언자" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal marks the feminine form of the Hebrew; Balanced and Readable use "예언자", as the English uses "prophet", since her calling is the same.

decisions.choice: thus says Yahweh: the messenger's formula
decisions.reason: A messenger began by naming the one whose words he carried. Prophets use the formula to show that what follows is Yahweh's word, not their own.

decisions.choice: the man who sent you: Huldah speaks of the king simply as "the man"
decisions.reason: Before Yahweh's sentence on Judah, the king is "the man who sent you". When the word turns to Josiah himself, she calls him "the king of Judah" (verse 18).

decisions.choice: Thus says the LORD / The LORD says this / This is what the LORD says
decisions.reason: The wording kept for the formula at each level in these books. Huldah's answer opens with a double quote mark here and closes at the end of her last words in verse 20; the message for the king opens with a single quote mark in verses 16 and 18.

decisions.choice: Huldah speaks to the envoys in the formal style; the LORD's words inside are 해라체 and call the king only "그 사람"
decisions.reason: The prophet is courteous to the king's men, but God's word names the king plainly as "the man" (meaning decision m2), which Korean keeps without a title.

decisions.choice: evil: disaster, harm brought as punishment
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means evil done or evil suffered. Here it is the disaster Yahweh brings as judgment, not wrongdoing (1 Kings 14:10; 21:21).

decisions.choice: all the words of the book: the disaster is what the book threatens
decisions.reason: "All the words of the book" stands beside "evil" and says what it is: the curses written in the book will now fall (Deuteronomy 28:15-68; 29:19-27). "This place" is Jerusalem and Judah.

decisions.choice: look, I am bringing: about to happen
decisions.reason: The word "look" with the participle announces something that is sure and near.

decisions.choice: disaster (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 14:10, Balanced and Readable say "disaster" for the harm Yahweh brings (m1); Literal keeps "evil".

decisions.choice: everything written in the book ... will happen (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable makes the words of the book a sentence of their own and supplies "will happen" to show how they belong to the disaster (m2).

decisions.choice: "desgracia"
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "desgracia" for the harm Yahweh brings (m1); Literal keeps "mal", as the English does.

decisions.choice: burned incense: or made offerings go up in smoke
decisions.reason: The verb means to make something go up in smoke, of incense or of offerings burned on an altar (12:4).

decisions.choice: provoke me to anger with the work of their hands: the words of Deuteronomy
alternatives: by all that they have done
decisions.reason: Moses warned that Israel would do evil and provoke Yahweh "with the work of your hands" (Deuteronomy 31:29; 4:28). The work of their hands is the idols they made, and may take in all their deeds.

decisions.choice: my wrath will be kindled ... will not be quenched: the judgment will not be turned back
decisions.reason: Yahweh's anger is pictured as a fire, as the king had said (verse 13). A fire that will not be put out means a sentence that will not be withdrawn (Jeremiah 7:20). 23:26-27 says that even Josiah's reform did not turn it back.

decisions.choice: abandoned (Balanced); left (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use common words for "forsaken". Readable adds "This will happen" to tie the reason to verse 16.

decisions.choice: like a fire that no one can put out (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says "like a fire" so that the picture in "will not be quenched" is plain (m3).

decisions.choice: the words that you have heard: the sentence breaks off
decisions.reason: The phrase stands alone and is not finished; the sentence starts again in verse 19 with "because". It means "as for the words you have heard", the words of the book.

decisions.choice: the king of Judah: now named by his office
decisions.reason: In verse 15 Huldah called him "the man who sent you". Now the word is for Josiah himself, and she names him as king.

decisions.choice: to inquire of Yahweh: as in verse 13
decisions.reason: To seek Yahweh's answer through a prophet.

decisions.choice: Thus says the LORD / The LORD says this / This is what the LORD says
decisions.reason: As in verse 15. A single quote mark opens the message for the king.

decisions.choice: "주께 여쭈라고" with the honorific in Huldah's words about the king's request; "주가 ... 말한다" in God's own words
decisions.reason: Huldah reports what the king did (asking God), where the honorific is natural; in the oracle God names himself, without -시-.

en.L: because your heart was soft and you humbled yourself before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} when you heard what I spoke against this place and against its inhabitants, that they would become a desolation and a curse, and you tore your clothes and wept before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, I also have heard, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: because your heart was tender, and when you heard what I spoke against this place and its people, that they would become a horror and a curse, you humbled yourself before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; and because you tore your clothes and wept before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, I in turn have heard you, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: When you heard what I said against this place and the people who live here, that it would become a ruin and a name people would use when they curse, your heart was moved and you made yourself humble before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. You tore your clothes and wept in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} presence. So I have listened to you, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
